changed: The Chores and Tasks lists now share one card style, so the two screens look and behave the same.

A task's coloured stripe now reflects how soon it is due (matching Chores and Memos) instead of its priority. Priority is now shown by a marker on the title: an exclamation for higher, a downward chevron for lower, so it stays readable without relying on colour.
fixed: Completed tasks no longer let the swipe action panel show through the card.
